fixes.claim: A full match of a 40-token question is strong evidence of exposure; 10% overlap on an 8-token question is not.
fixes.problem: An 8-token item has a single 8-gram at the default n=8, so its overlap is only 0 or 1; '10% on an 8-token question' cannot occur and the contrast is misleading.
fixes.replacement: A full match of a 40-token question (all 33 of its 8-grams) is strong evidence of exposure; one matching 8-gram out of 33 (about 3%) may just be a quoted phrase, and an 8-token item has only a single 8-gram at n=8, so its overlap can only be 0 or 1.
